porady: Check the nearest shelter point on the map now and plan your way there.
The alarm is a modulated (rising and falling) siren tone for 3 minutes; the all-clear is a steady tone for 3 minutes.
When you hear the alarm, turn on the radio or TV and follow the announcements.
Inside a building, go to a room without windows, so that at least two solid walls separate you from the outside. Use the stairs, not the lift.

Outdoors, go to the nearest shelter point if you can get there safely (points marked “On request” may be closed). If not, take cover in an underground car park, a tunnel or a building with solid walls.
If you hear an explosion in open ground, lie down, ideally in a hollow, and cover your head.
Do not leave your place of shelter too early. Send text messages instead of calling, so the network is not overloaded.
